correctness.rationale: Substituting arbitrary generator images via the derivation rule extends uniquely and preserves the ideal of lengths greater than c. The length filtration is triangular; fixed degree-one matrix A has q^{2(N_c−2)} lifts, all with the same invertibility. Over an algebraic closure triangularize A and filter each degree by the count of its second basis vector: off-diagonal substitutions move that count in only one direction, whereas the multidegree (i,j) diagonal acts by iλ+jν. This closes the nonsemisimple case without assuming both basis vectors are eigenvectors. Every mixed multidegree is nonzero in every characteristic: (ad x)^{i−1}(ad y)^{j−1}[x,y] has coefficient (−1)^{j−1} on x^i y^j in the tensor algebra. Pure degrees above one vanish by alternation. Thus (p,p) is an unavoidable zero weight from class 2p, and below it the only mixed obstructions for invertible A are the stated slopes, closed under inversion. For irreducible roots λ,λ^q, a ratio in F_p would equal its own reciprocal; equality to 1 is impossible and equality to −1 is trace zero, already forbidden by degree two. The irreducible trace-zero polynomials are counted by the trace-zero subspace of F_{q²}: q−1 non-base-field elements for odd p and zero for p=2, divided by 2. For trace t, determinant d, counting off-diagonal pairs via bc=a(t−a)−d independently yields q(q−1+r) matrices, where r is the number of distinct F_q roots of X²−tX+d; r=0,2,1 gives exactly the irreducible, split and repeated sizes, respectively. The split allowed ordered-pair count is (q−1)(q−2−e+δ) and the repeated count contributes only if 1 is not forbidden. For c≥p every nonzero prime-subfield slope already occurs using i=1. The Witt dimension and lift factor then give the normalized plateau. Independent trace/determinant replay over p=2,3,5,7,11 through class 2p, testing ij t²+(i−j)²d for every mixed weight, reproduced the prime-field boundary cases, positivity, plateau and vanishing.
residual_risks: The trace/determinant enumeration is bounded, not a proof across fields; the characteristic-independent filtration and exact counts provide that proof. The bracket is alternating and ordinary, not restricted; passage to nonfree quotients can remove weights.

Resultary Heisenberg prior case for the incremental higher-class comparison
value.rationale: Nonsingularity is a natural test on the full derivation space of free nilpotent Lie algebras. Beyond the already covered class-two case, the count diagnoses exactly when a free multidegree forces failure, how prime-subfield slopes remove split choices, and why the density stays positive and constant across a whole class interval before becoming zero. The family is unbounded in fields and classes and the mechanism is not numerical enumeration or arbitrary slicing.
residual_risks: This does not count determinant fibers, singular ranks or conjugacy classes, and exact counts for nonfree quotients require checking which multidegrees survive.
